query:
SELECT count(*) AS "total!"
  FROM (
        SELECT 1
          FROM tools.uses tu
         WHERE ($1::timestamptz IS NULL OR tu.created_at >= $1)
           AND ($2::text IS NULL OR tu.tool_name = $2)
           AND ($3::text IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                   FROM requests.requests rq
                   JOIN projects.projects p ON p.id = rq.project_id
                  WHERE rq.id = tu.request_id
                    AND p.project_path = $3))
           AND ($4::text IS NULL OR tu.session_id = (SELECT x.id FROM sessions.sessions x
                                                       WHERE x.session_uuid = sessions.try_uuid($4)))
           AND (NOT $5::boolean OR tu.id IN (SELECT r.tool_use_id FROM tools.results r WHERE r.is_error))
         LIMIT $6
       ) capped
